title: Megataur
summary: Megataur is a half-bull, half-man Titan bound by gold chains. This Titan is considered a symbol of the Sutos nobility and as such will only bond with a Seeker of the Sutos Island royal family. Megataur was used by Zan-Sutos before its Amulet was given to his son, Grier.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: The ancient Greek legend of the Minotaur is based on the [[Titan]] known as Megataur, who was used by emperors and [[Seekers]] alike to guard labyrinths. The unlucky few who were smart enough to navigate these complex mazes faced the powerful Megataur as their "reward." {{source|Huntik.com}}

sections.heading: Grier's Megataur
sections.text:
Megataur was the royal fighting Titan of the royal family of Sutos Island. After Megataur's Seeker, Zan-Sutos, was killed, his Amulet was hidden away by the royal Governor, not wanting the Titan to fall in to the wrong hands. [Like Father Unlike Son]

Upon Grier's return to Sutos with the Organization backing him to restore order to the island, the Governor bestowed Megataur's Amulet to Grier as the son of the true king of Sutos. Being of noble blood and intentions, Grier was able to bond with Megataur. Grier later invoked him to attack Dante Vale's Caliban and was later seen fighting Dante's Metagolem. Megataur was invoked again alongside Breaker against Caliban and Metagolem when Grier and Dante prepared to fight to the end. The battle was averted when Grier revealed his true motive for taking over Sutos was his father, and that he was actually bringing peace to an island plagued with war. Having resolved their differences, Grier allowed Dante and his team to leave. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Grier invoked Megataur in the Professor's castle to fight alongside Lok Lambert's Powerbonded Baselaird whilst helping Dante's team recover a file on Rassimov. Megataur fought Hoffman's Doberman and two Undergolem Titans summoned by Eathon the dog. After a fierce battle, Megataur was defeated by one of the Undergolems. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Sophie's Megataur
sections.wikitext: Another Megataur Titan was captured by the Dark Guardians and chained up in a dark dungeon. After defeating the mysterious blue puzzle cubes, [[Sophie Casterwill]] was able to rescue the Titan and call him back to his [[Amulet]]. {{source|Huntik 5D}}
sections.text: Another Megataur Titan was captured by the Dark Guardians and chained up in a dark dungeon. After defeating the mysterious blue puzzle cubes, Sophie Casterwill was able to rescue the Titan and call him back to his Amulet. [Huntik 5D]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Megataur is strong and powerful, and is fairly quick on his feet despite his size. His horned charge ability is very useful when taking down opponents, as his horns are very sharp. However, the horns can also be a disadvantage, as they can be easily grabbed by the opponent. In addition, Megataur packs a powerful punch. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}} Megataur can also choose to fight with a large battle axe. {{source|Like Father Unlike Son}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* His summoning command in Season 2 is '''"Fight On"'''.

* Megataur is based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minotaur Minotaur] from Greek mythology, a half-man half-bull monster imprisoned in a labyrinth. This motif appears prominently in the unreleased TCG set ''[[TCG:Labyrinth of Doom|Labyrinth of Doom]]'' and was later explored in the ''[[Huntik 5D]]'' attraction.

* Following the cancellation of his card with the ''[[Labyrinth of Doom]]'' set, Megataur is the only named [[Titan]] from Season 1, other than [[Goblin Brownie]], not to have a card released in the ''[[Huntik Trading Card Game]]''.
* Megataur appeared on the cover of Issue #1 of ''Huntik Magazine'' despite not appearing in the comic, [[The School of Mystery]]. This was likely due to the fact the issue featured fact files on the individual [[Krono-Titans]] including Megataur himself.
* The background supervisor for the show, Tommaso Gomez, stated that Megataur was the "character he most identified with". {{Extsource|1=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjYWmvnOqQo&list=PL6NZlSvyFyQU-o6alH6pXfEqPNXEBFSQo|2=YouTube}}

full_text:
Megataur is a half-bull, half-man Titan bound by gold chains. This Titan is considered a symbol of the Sutos nobility and as such will only bond with a Seeker of the Sutos Island royal family. Megataur was used by Zan-Sutos before its Amulet was given to his son, Grier.

== History ==
The ancient Greek legend of the Minotaur is based on the Titan known as Megataur, who was used by emperors and Seekers alike to guard labyrinths. The unlucky few who were smart enough to navigate these complex mazes faced the powerful Megataur as their "reward." [Huntik.com]

=== Grier's Megataur ===
Megataur was the royal fighting Titan of the royal family of Sutos Island. After Megataur's Seeker, Zan-Sutos, was killed, his Amulet was hidden away by the royal Governor, not wanting the Titan to fall in to the wrong hands. [Like Father Unlike Son]

Upon Grier's return to Sutos with the Organization backing him to restore order to the island, the Governor bestowed Megataur's Amulet to Grier as the son of the true king of Sutos. Being of noble blood and intentions, Grier was able to bond with Megataur. Grier later invoked him to attack Dante Vale's Caliban and was later seen fighting Dante's Metagolem. Megataur was invoked again alongside Breaker against Caliban and Metagolem when Grier and Dante prepared to fight to the end. The battle was averted when Grier revealed his true motive for taking over Sutos was his father, and that he was actually bringing peace to an island plagued with war. Having resolved their differences, Grier allowed Dante and his team to leave. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Grier invoked Megataur in the Professor's castle to fight alongside Lok Lambert's Powerbonded Baselaird whilst helping Dante's team recover a file on Rassimov. Megataur fought Hoffman's Doberman and two Undergolem Titans summoned by Eathon the dog. After a fierce battle, Megataur was defeated by one of the Undergolems. [An Ally from the Organization]

=== Sophie's Megataur ===
Another Megataur Titan was captured by the Dark Guardians and chained up in a dark dungeon. After defeating the mysterious blue puzzle cubes, Sophie Casterwill was able to rescue the Titan and call him back to his Amulet. [Huntik 5D]

== Abilities ==
Megataur is strong and powerful, and is fairly quick on his feet despite his size. His horned charge ability is very useful when taking down opponents, as his horns are very sharp. However, the horns can also be a disadvantage, as they can be easily grabbed by the opponent. In addition, Megataur packs a powerful punch. [An Ally from the Organization] Megataur can also choose to fight with a large battle axe. [Like Father Unlike Son]
